docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Hornell’s monograph on the sacred conch of India, its natural history, the chank fisheries and its place in Hindu worship, medicine and ornament (Madras, 1914). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Smithsonian Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: The sacred chank of India; a monograph of the Indian conch (Turbinella pyrum) · Hornell, James, 1865-1949 · 1914, 244 scanned pages. Published 1914; James Hornell died 1949; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
